checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '[.primary_live.audit.events[]? // empty] | map(select((.event_type|tostring)|test(\"auth|readiness|scope|extension|error|failure\";\"i\")))' out/production-validation/latest.json 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{preflight:{ok:.preflight.ok,git:.preflight.git,checks:(.preflight.checks|map({name,ok,detail}))},primary_live:{run_id:.primary_live.run_id,outcome:.primary_live.outcome,terminal_classification:.primary_live.terminal_classification,validation_classification:.primary_live.validation_classification,extension_build_pass:.primary_live.extension_build_pass,bridge_restart_pass:.primary_live.bridge_restart_pass,pass:.primary_live.pass,metrics:.primary_live.validation_metrics,scope:.primary_live.scope,dashboard:.primary_live.dashboard,run_audit_platforms:(.primary_live.audit.platforms // {})}}' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -c '.internal_failures, .external_blockers, .exit_integrity' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{primary:{run_id:.primary_live.run_id,outcome:.primary_live.outcome,terminal:.primary_live.terminal_classification,validation:.primary_live.validation_classification,pass:.primary_live.pass,extension_build_pass:.primary_live.extension_build_pass,bridge_restart_pass:.primary_live.bridge_restart_pass,dashboard_identity_ok:.primary_live.dashboard.identity_ok,live_refresh_ok:.primary_live.dashboard.live_refresh_ok,metrics:(.primary_live.validation_metrics|{integrity,reconciliation,attempted_tasks,progress_tasks,attempted_failed,attempted_incomplete,attempted_running,extracted,persistence_attempted,persisted,persistence_failed,detail_pending,detail_complete,detail_retryable,detail_external_blocked,task_states,unexplained}),scope:.primary_live.scope}}' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{preflight_checks:(.preflight.checks|map({name,ok})),deterministic:.preflight.deterministic,run_now_coverage:.run_now_coverage}' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -c '[.primary_live.audit.platforms | to_entries[] | {platform:.key, state:(.value|{planned,queued,running,exhausted,incomplete,challenged,auth_required,deferred_by_platform,failed,results,persisted,detail_complete,detail_retryable,detail_external_blocked,readiness_state,readiness_reason,auth_status,auth_reason})}]' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{task_states:.primary_live.validation_metrics.task_states,unexplained:.primary_live.validation_metrics.unexplained,scope:.primary_live.scope}' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{local_tests:.preflight.deterministic.local_tests.returncode,scope_fixtures:.preflight.deterministic.scope_fixtures,platform_isolation:.preflight.deterministic.platform_isolation,watch_cadence:.preflight.deterministic.watch_cadence,watch_stop_latch:.preflight.deterministic.watch_stop_latch,compileall:(.preflight.checks[]|select(.name==\"compileall\")|.ok),node_syntax:(.preflight.checks[]|select(.name==\"node syntax\")|.ok),plan:(.preflight.checks[]|select(.name==\"uncapped staged/deep search plan\")|.detail)}' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '[.primary_live.audit.platforms | to_entries[] | {platform:.key, planned:.value.planned,queued:.value.queued,running:.value.running,exhausted:.value.exhausted,incomplete:.value.incomplete,challenged:.value.challenged,auth_required:.value.auth_required,deferred_by_platform:.value.deferred_by_platform,failed:.value.failed,results:.value.results,persisted:.value.persisted,detail_complete:.value.detail_complete,detail_retryable:.value.detail_retryable,detail_external_blocked:.value.detail_external_blocked,auth_status:.value.auth_status,readiness_state:.value.readiness_state,auth_reason:.value.auth_reason,readiness_reason:.value.readiness_reason}]' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.internal_failures[]' out/production-validation/latest.json && rtk jq -c '.external_blockers' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.external_blockers[] | [.stage,.platform,(.states|tojson)] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.primary_live.scope | to_entries[] | [.key,.value.scope_missing_events,.value.contamination_persisted,.value.attempted_pages,.value.scope_found_events,.value.persisted_in_scope,.value.persisted_outside_scope] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.primary_live.validation_metrics.task_states | to_entries[] | [.key,.value] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json; rtk jq -r '.primary_live.validation_metrics | [.integrity,.reconciliation.ok,.unexplained,.extracted,.persistence_attempted,.persisted,.persistence_failed,.progress_tasks,.attempted_tasks] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,360p' verification/CHG-22-r4.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n -i --hidden -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!.git'"' 'auth_state is not defined|ReferenceError|extraction_scope_missing|search_scope_recovery|scope_context|context loss' data out logs verification 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc 'for db in data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_indeed_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_glassdoor_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3; do echo "DB=$db"; rtk sqlite3 -separator '"'|' \""'$db" "select '"'event',event_type,message from browser_events where lower(message) like '%auth_state is not defined%' or lower(message) like '%referenceerror%' or event_type in ('extraction_scope_missing','search_scope_recovery','scope_diagnostics'); select 'task_state',t.platform,t.status,p.auth_status,p.readiness_state,t.last_error from browser_search_tasks t join browser_platform_runs p on p.browser_run_id=t.browser_run_id and p.platform=t.platform where t.status='auth_required' or (t.status='auth_required' and p.auth_status in ('retryable','unknown'));\" 2>/dev/null || true; done"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all && rtk git rev-parse HEAD && rtk git diff --quiet e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a --; echo target_drift=$? && rtk git diff-index --quiet e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a --; echo worktree_drift=$?'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sqlite3 -header -column data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3 \"select event_id,event_type,message,payload_json from browser_events where event_type='extension_build' or event_type='extension_refresh_requested' or event_type in ('auth_failed','platform_paused','platform_readiness','run_finished') order by event_id;\" 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk sqlite3 -header -column data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3 "select browser_run_id,status,auth_status,jobs_recorded,jobs_new,jobs_updated,notes from browser_runs; select platform,auth_status,auth_reason,readiness_state,readiness_reason,tasks_total,tasks_completed,tasks_incomplete,tasks_challenged,tasks_failed,jobs_recorded from browser_platform_runs; select task_id,platform,query_text,status,results_seen,pages_visited,detail_count_read,last_error from browser_search_tasks;" 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n '3\\.2\\.2-prod-ready\\.672cf88(?"'!'"\\.11)' src extension config verification out/production-validation/latest.json -g '"'!*.sqlite3'"' 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.primary_live | {run_id,outcome,terminal_classification,validation_classification,extension_build_pass,bridge_restart_pass,pass,metrics,scope}' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk sqlite3 -header -column data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3 "select event_type,count(*) n from browser_events group by event_type order by event_type; select event_id,event_type,message from browser_events order by event_id limit 30;" 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n --pcre2 '3\\.2\\.2-prod-ready\\.672cf88(?"'!'"\\.11)' src extension config verification out/production-validation/latest.json -g '"'!*.sqlite3'"' 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.primary_live.audit | keys' out/production-validation/latest.json && rtk jq -r '.primary_live.audit.events // \"NO_EVENTS\"' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk .venv/bin/python -c 'from pathlib import Path; import json; p=Path(\"extension/manifest.json\"); print(json.loads(p.read_text())[\"version_name\"]); from jobbot.extension_identity import extension_build; from jobbot.config import PROJECT_ROOT; print(extension_build(PROJECT_ROOT))'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sqlite3 -header -column data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3 \"select event_type,count(*) as count from browser_events where event_type in ('extraction_scope_missing','search_scope_recovery','scope_diagnostics') group by event_type; select count(*) as ref_or_auth_errors from browser_events where lower(message) like '%auth_state is not defined%' or lower(message) like '%referenceerror%'; select count(*) as contradictory_auth_downgrades from browser_search_tasks t join browser_platform_runs p on p.browser_run_id=t.browser_run_id and p.platform=t.platform where t.status='auth_required' and p.auth_status in ('retryable','unknown');\" 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '{PROD_READY,validation_database,soak_database,semi_production_database,exit_integrity,internal_failures,external_blockers}' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk shasum -a 256 out/production-validation/latest.json data/verification_prereq_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_indeed_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_glassdoor_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 2>/dev/null || true'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^{tree} && rtk git show -s --format='"'%H%n%P%n%s' e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a && rtk git diff --name-only e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a -- && rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '[.validation_database,.soak_database,.semi_production_database][], (.exit_integrity|to_entries[]|[.key,.value]|@tsv)[]' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.primary_live | [.run_id,.outcome.status,.outcome.bridge_restarts,.terminal_classification,.validation_classification,.extension_build_pass,.bridge_restart_pass,.pass,.dashboard.identity_ok,.dashboard.live_refresh_ok] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json; rtk jq -r '.primary_live.validation_metrics | [.integrity,.reconciliation.ok,.unexplained,.extracted,.persistence_attempted,.persisted,.persistence_failed,.progress_tasks,.attempted_tasks] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "for db in data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_indeed_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_glassdoor_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3; do rtk sqlite3 -separator '|' \""'$db" "select platform,auth_status,auth_reason,readiness_state,readiness_reason,tasks_total,tasks_completed,tasks_incomplete,tasks_challenged,tasks_failed,jobs_recorded from browser_platform_runs; select count(*) as complete_enriched from search_task_results where detail_status='"'COMPLETE' and content_state='COMPLETE';\"; done"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.exit_integrity | to_entries[] | [.key,.value] | @tsv' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.exit_integrity | values[]' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "for db in data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_indeed_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_glassdoor_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3; do rtk sqlite3 -separator '|' \""'$db" "select '"'"'$(basename "$db")'"', (select count(*) from browser_events where event_type in ('extraction_scope_missing','search_scope_recovery','scope_diagnostics')), (select count(*) from browser_events where lower(message) like '%auth_state is not defined%' or lower(message) like '%referenceerror%'), (select count(*) from browser_search_tasks t join browser_platform_runs p on p.browser_run_id=t.browser_run_id and p.platform=t.platform where t.status='auth_required' and p.auth_status in ('retryable','unknown'));\"; done"

/bin/zsh -lc "for db in data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_indeed_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/verification_glassdoor_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 data/validation_20260919T003727Z.sqlite3; do rtk sqlite3 -separator '|' \""'$db" "select '"'"'$(basename "$db")'"', group_concat(distinct message) from browser_events where event_type='extension_build';\"; done"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.preflight.checks[] | select(.name==\"deterministic suite\") | .detail.output | split(\"\\n\") | .[-8:][]' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.preflight.deterministic.local_tests.output | split(\"\\n\") | .[-8:][]' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.preflight.checks[] | select(.name==\"node syntax\") | .detail | length' out/production-validation/latest.json; rtk jq -r '.preflight.checks[] | select(.name==\"uncapped staged/deep search plan\") | .detail | @json' out/production-validation/latest.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.preflight.deterministic.local_tests.output | split(\"\\n\")[] | select(test(\"Ran |OK|skipped\"))' out/production-validation/latest.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk sqlite3 -header -column data/verification_linkedin_20260918T000000Z.sqlite3 "select task_id,platform,query_text,status,results_seen,pages_visited,detail_count_read,last_error from browser_search_tasks order by task_id;" 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n 'bridge_token=|X-JobBot-Token|cookie|password|credential|api[_-]?key|secret' verification/CHG-39-r9.json -i || true; rtk wc -c verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq empty verification/CHG-39-r9.json && rtk jq '{verification_result,PROD_READY,source_identity,full_production_validation:{exit_code,PROD_READY,internal_failures,external_blockers}}' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.isolated_databases[] | [.stage,.classification,.production_database,.integrity // \"n/a\"] | @tsv' verification/CHG-39-r9.json; rtk jq -r '.big3_bounded_warmup | to_entries[] | [.key,.value.auth_status,.value.readiness_state,.value.reason,.value.content_complete_records] | @tsv' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all && rtk git diff --name-only && rtk git diff --cached --name-only && rtk git rev-parse HEAD && rtk git diff --quiet e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a --; echo tracked_target_diff=$?'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq '.full_production_validation' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.chg132_regression_observations, .chg127_recovery_observations' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq empty verification/CHG-39-r9.json && rtk jq -r '[.PROD_READY,.verification_result,.source_identity.head_matches_target,.runtime_identity.refresh_gate.identity_confirmed,.full_production_validation.exit_code,.linkedin_substantive_detail_proof.go_permitted] | @json' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.full_production_validation | {exit_code,PROD_READY,preflight_ok,internal_failures,external_blockers,soak_started,semi_production_started}' verification/CHG-39-r9.json && rtk jq -r '.big3_bounded_warmup | to_entries[] | [.key,.value.status,.value.auth_status,.value.readiness_state,.value.reason,.value.content_complete_records] | @tsv' verification/CHG-39-r9.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all && rtk git diff --name-only && rtk git diff --cached --name-only && rtk git rev-parse HEAD && rtk git diff --quiet e5ccd65c84f5b42bcb29a3ab3481f5dafa6eb10a --; echo tracked_diff_from_target=$?'
